title: Connecting Solar to the Grid is Harder Than You Think
summary: Practical Engineering explains why connecting solar and other inverter-based generation to the grid is hard. It covers grid stability, load balancing and the behind-the-scenes engineering challenges of renewables.
why: HN people link it as the go-to explainer for grid and inverter stability, especially in threads about blackouts and distributed solar.

quote.text: Just watch this Practical Engineering video [1], if you are not familiar with the topic.
